title: FilletFeature
description: Parametric Fillet feature: rounds selected edges with a given radius. Stub implementation stores intent; full mesh fillet (rolling-ball) is deferred. Intended for manufacturing (stress relief, tool access).

radius.description: Fillet radius: numeric value or parameter name / expression string. Positive.

edges.description: Optional list of edge identifiers or mesh edge indices to fillet. Empty or omitted means all edges (or deferred selection).

operation.description: Intent: modify the current solid by filleting edges. Full Boolean-style application deferred.
